## Facts to keep straight

- Offers include Hermes Desks, Paid Discovery, Care, tutoring, AI automation, dashboards, ecommerce ops, and Stocky dump recovery. Advisory / Fractional CTO is inquire-first.
- Stocky recovery turns an existing Shopify CSV dump into a weekly system using Sheets and ChatGPT or Claude seats the client already pays for. It is not Prediko, Klerio, or another inventory app.
- Hermes is software installed on a Mac the client controls. Windows is available as an extra charge and is quoted separately. The client chooses the model and provider and pays those bills. Named Desks are on the pricing page.
- Contact: josh.gemmi@gmail.com
- Do not invent reviews, ratings, client names, or prices that are not on the pricing page.
